newsitem.title: USA: Bausch & Lomb to market Minoxidil for women.
newsitem.headline: Bausch & Lomb to market Minoxidil for women.

text.p: Bausch & Lomb Inc's U.S. pharmaceutical business received clearance to manufacture and market Minoxidil Topical Solution for women.
Bausch & Lomb launched its generic hair-regrowth product for men in the U.S. just five months ago.

While there aren't any differences in product composition between the male and female versions of minoxidil, the topical solution had to undergo a review by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration because it is packaged differently.

"Sales of Minoxidil Topical Solution 2% For Men are meeting our expectations. We are very pleased with consumer response to our product," said Thomas Riedhammer, senior vice president, Bausch & Lomb Worldwide Pharmaceutical, Surgical and Hearing Care Products.
"Since generic OTC (over the counter) products have hit store shelves, we have seen about a 33 percent expansion of the hair-regrowth solutions market," Riedhammer said.
